title: Lenspost Labs
tagline:
Crosschain Canva - Unlocking expressions with NFTs! 
Make memes, gifs, infographics & more with your collectibles and split revenues with other creators who's assets you have used!
description:
> There are no web3 native creator tools! We are in an era where we have web3 version of twitter, web3 version of youtube/twitch etc but we are still using right-click-save-as to create content out of our NFTs, every GM or shitpost is a 25 click user journey!

> Also web2 tools like canva don't really understand web3 native culture! We solve all this and more with our on-chain + cross chain canvas. 

>Another big industry issue is cross chain revenue share for co-creation (for example, basepaint pays out all collaboraters in BASE eth!) There exists NO CROSS CHAIN COLLAB / CO-CREATION TOOLS. We are solving for this by enabling cross chain revnue splits.

> We all  know how important/critical to success meme marketing is in crypto. Organic content posted by community is the BEST marketing.
Never in the history of memes, has the template creator been attributed - they are the unsung heros; we are attempting to change this by giving template creators a brand new way to get onchain revenue by dropping viral worthy meme templates into our community pool.

TL:DR:
This is what we are solving: 

1) Giving onchain assets & collectibles an easy-drag-drop/ one-click remix front end (So collectors with Zero Design skills too can shitpost like a king)
2)While our front end is a CANVA, our back end is not only a REPO for brand assets, cc0 NFTs but also NFT INFRA for cross chain revenue splits. We currently support L2s like BASE, Polygon, Zora, etc + Solana.
3) Creating a brand new reveue stream for creators - drop templates and earn everytime they're remixed!
how_its_made:
1. For chainlink, we faced issue while correcting the price feed with respective to matic / eth pair 
2. Airstack was not resolving some addresses properly, which were having lens profile
3. Xmtp is showing not on the network for majority all the profile
4. While making open action for base, the UX flow was not good, user have to switch to base mainnet and then polygon mainnet to post a post on lens protocol
